answer: The fee is charged through an echo debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the opal totals, and the gale anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 27 units per epoch, sustaining 103 aliases for 52 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The deposit is 81 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
